template.name: Daily BreakPoint
template.entry_long: close > open * {p0} and close - open >= {p1} * atr(high,low,close,{p0})
template.notes: A 2% move from the current bar open and a body of at least half ATR(14) proxy the separate daily-open and body-size rules; 2% is an explicit fallback because pips are unsupplied. The daily stream, pips stops, trailing step, and session state are unavailable.
